_note: Closed support tickets (fictional fixture data). Each is a snapshot of what was true when it closed. Vol 3 Chapter 1.

tickets.text: Asked how long delivery takes for the desk lamp order #1234. Told orders usually arrive within 5 business days.
NW-500 headphones battery stopped charging after two months. Replaced under the 12-month warranty.
Asked whether a gift card can be exchanged for cash. Told gift cards cannot be exchanged for cash.
Can I return my mug set order #2001? Snapshot of order #2001: status in transit, not delivered yet, so no return is possible until it arrives.
Asked about the clearance jacket order #4410. Told it is final sale.
Asked how to reset the NW-500 headphones. Pointed to the manual: hold the power button for 10 seconds.
